title: TONSTAD chair
description: TONSTAD chair, oak effect/Fridtuna light beige Wooden ladder-back chair with padded seat brings elegance and comfort to the table. Washable covers simplify upkeep. Pairs perfectly with TONSTAD tables and storage for a cohesive look.
features: A bit screwdriver is required to assemble this chair, sold separately as a part of TRIXIG 15-piece toolset.
To prevent surface scratches, complete with TRIXIG stick-on floor protectors, sold separately.
Combines with other products in the TONSTAD series.
materialAndCare: Fabric: 78 % cotton, 22% polyester (min. 90% recycled); Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Frame: Solid wood, Adhesive, Printed acrylic paint, Clear acrylic lacquer; Seat: Fiberboard, Polyurethane foam 2.2 lb/cu.ft., Clear lacquer; Fabric cover: 78 % cotton, 22 %polyester; Thread: 100 %polyester
